desc: The Canik Mete MC9L is chambered in 9mm, with a capacity of 17+1rds, and accept all standard and extended capacity Canik magazines. The MC9L supports an overall length of 6.27 inches, a width of 1.14 inches, a height of 5.43 inches, a 3.18 inch barrel length, and an unloaded weight of 22.22 ounces. The MC9L will be initially offered in black, flat dark earth (FDE), and two tone black/FDE.
